questions.prompt: How do the figures of 7,000 and 54,300 differ in the article?
options: The first counts new agreements, while the second counts first-window payments.
The first counts small farms, while the second counts hectares under agreement.
The first counts expiring agreements, while the second counts second-window applicants.
The first counts applications; the second counts businesses holding live agreements overall.
questions.explanationZh: 7,000是第一轮申请数，54,300是整体持有生效协议的经营主体数；阶段及覆盖范围均不同。

questions.prompt: How are the £50 million and £3 million related to the £233 million fund?
options: They are additional payments to be added after the £233 million.
They are amounts already included within the £233 million.
They are deductions that reduce the £233 million before applications.
They are estimates of what individual farms will receive from £233 million.
questions.explanationZh: 两笔金额已包含在2.33亿之中，不能重复相加；也不是扣款或单个农场所得。

questions.prompt: Why might category totals exceed the overall business total?
options: The categories include future agreements that the overall total leaves out.
The categories measure land area rather than the number of businesses.
One business identifier may be associated with several different agreements.
Each business is counted both when applying and when receiving payment.
questions.explanationZh: 同一识别码可与多份协议关联，分类小计会有重叠；不是未来协议、土地面积或申请与付款阶段的重复计数。

questions.prompt: Which claim is not established by the first-window figures?
options: Every applicant had already received a payment.
The window attracted applications from small farms.
Some new agreements were live by 1 September.
Applications and payments represented different process stages.
questions.explanationZh: s7明确没有给出全部7,000名申请者都获款的总数；其他三项由正文直接支持。

questions.prompt: Which description of the accompanying analysis is accurate?
options: It uses unrounded application figures collected after the second window opened.
It counts individual farm workers from a survey of participating households.
It reports environmental changes measured after the first payments arrived.
It uses rounded agency management information extracted on 18 September.
questions.explanationZh: 数据提取日为9月18日，是经过舍入的管理信息，并不直接测量每个农场的环境改善。
